format: Project-defined JSON and XYZ CSV; the NASA tutorial does not define an interchange API.
scope: Flat focus-centered ellipse, sequential Y/Z/X rotations and Kepler timing follow the tutorial method. Classical elements use the standard Z/X/Z orbital convention; an explicit Euler conversion connects the conventions. Independent source implementation; no NASA repository code copied.
